<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-start="0" data-end="409"> </p>
<h1 style="text-align: center;" data-section-id="19m7j5s" data-start="411" data-end="470">Kitesurf Trip to Sri Lanka –</h1>
<h1 style="text-align: center;" data-section-id="19m7j5s" data-start="411" data-end="470">Christmas &amp; New Year 2026/27</h1>
<h2 style="text-align: center;" data-section-id="1vkr1y2" data-start="472" data-end="509">Ride. Explore. Discover Sri Lanka.</h2>
<p data-start="511" data-end="619">Escape Dubai this winter and join us for an unforgettable <strong data-start="569" data-end="618">kitesurfing adventure in Kalpitiya, Sri Lanka</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="621" data-end="831">Stay at <strong data-start="629" data-end="655">Arasi Resort Kalpitiya</strong> and spend your days riding tropical lagoons, discovering remote islands by boat, progressing your kitesurfing with our coaches and enjoying the laid-back Sri Lankan lifestyle.</p>
<p data-start="833" data-end="1043">Whether you&#8217;re still learning, an independent rider or an experienced kitesurfer looking for new spots, the trip is designed around one thing: <strong data-start="976" data-end="1043">maximum time on the water and a real Sri Lankan kite adventure.</strong></p>
<div class="no-scrollbar flex min-h-36 flex-nowrap gap-0.5 overflow-auto sm:gap-1 sm:overflow-hidden xl:min-h-44 mt-1 mb-5 not-first:mt-4">

<hr data-start="1087" data-end="1090" />
<h2 data-section-id="1oimykz" data-start="1092" data-end="1111">Three Trip Dates</h2>
<p data-start="1113" data-end="1153">Choose the week that works best for you:</p>
<p data-start="1155" data-end="1202"><strong data-start="1155" data-end="1173">Christmas Trip</strong><br data-start="1173" data-end="1176" />📅 <strong data-start="1179" data-end="1202">21–25 December 2026</strong></p>
<p data-start="1204" data-end="1264"><strong data-start="1204" data-end="1221">New Year Trip</strong><br data-start="1221" data-end="1224" />📅 <strong data-start="1227" data-end="1264">28 December 2026 – 2 January 2027</strong></p>
<p data-start="1266" data-end="1308"><strong data-start="1266" data-end="1282">January Trip</strong><br data-start="1282" data-end="1285" />📅 <strong data-start="1288" data-end="1308">4–8 January 2027</strong></p>
<p data-start="1310" data-end="1369">📍 <strong data-start="1313" data-end="1337">Kalpitiya, Sri Lanka</strong><br data-start="1337" data-end="1340" />🏨 <strong data-start="1343" data-end="1369">Arasi Resort Kalpitiya</strong></p>
<p data-start="1371" data-end="1506">Each trip combines <strong data-start="1390" data-end="1506">daily kitesurfing, coaching, boat-supported kite adventures, island exploration and time to relax at the resort.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="1508" data-end="1511" />
<h1 data-section-id="1gkdu5h" data-start="1513" data-end="1529">Why Kalpitiya?</h1>
<p data-start="1531" data-end="1599">Kalpitiya is one of Sri Lanka&#8217;s best-known kitesurfing destinations.</p>
<p data-start="1601" data-end="1915">The area combines large lagoons, shallow flat-water areas, ocean riding and remote sandbanks and islands. During the winter season, which runs roughly from mid-December to mid-March, local kite centres report predominantly <strong data-start="1824" data-end="1876">northwesterly winds averaging around 15–22 knots</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="1917" data-end="2010">That makes our December and January dates perfectly positioned within the winter kite season.</p>
<p data-start="2012" data-end="2066">The real beauty of Kalpitiya, however, is the variety.</p>
<p data-start="2068" data-end="2236">One day you can be working on transitions in the lagoon. The next you can load the kites onto a boat and head towards a remote island for an entirely different session.</p>
<hr data-start="2238" data-end="2241" />
<h1 data-section-id="qav7y0" data-start="2243" data-end="2268">Your Kitesurf Adventure</h1>
<p data-start="2270" data-end="2317">This isn&#8217;t just a week of riding the same spot.</p>
<p data-start="2319" data-end="2467">Our objective is to explore the <strong data-start="2351" data-end="2376">Kalpitiya kite region</strong>, combining daily riding with boat trips and different locations whenever conditions allow.</p>
<p data-start="2469" data-end="2492">Possible spots include:</p>
<p data-start="2494" data-end="2701"><strong data-start="2494" data-end="2514">Kalpitiya Lagoon</strong> – the main riding area, with a long sandbank and plenty of space. Its flat-water sections make it particularly suitable for lessons and progression.</p>
<p data-start="2703" data-end="2914"><strong data-start="2703" data-end="2717">Navy Point</strong> – located at the northern end of the Kalpitiya peninsula. It is particularly relevant during the winter season and offers shallow, flat water reached by boat.</p>
<p data-start="2916" data-end="3145"><strong data-start="2916" data-end="2930">Dream Spot</strong> – a beautiful sandbank environment where lagoon and ocean conditions meet. Depending on seasonal conditions, it offers the possibility of combining flat-water and ocean riding.</p>
<p data-start="3147" data-end="3400"><strong data-start="3147" data-end="3163">Vella Island</strong> – one of the area&#8217;s legendary kite destinations, famous for its remote setting and large areas of extremely flat water. It is approximately a 45-minute boat journey from some Kalpitiya kite centres.</p>
<div class="no-scrollbar flex min-h-36 flex-nowrap gap-0.5 overflow-auto sm:gap-1 sm:overflow-hidden xl:min-h-44 mt-1 mb-5 not-first:mt-4">
<div class="border-token-border-default relative w-32 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-[0.5px] md:shrink max-h-64 sm:w-[calc((100%-0.5rem)/3)] rounded-s-xl">

<div class="border-token-border-default relative w-32 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-[0.5px] md:shrink max-h-64 sm:w-[calc((100%-0.5rem)/3)] rounded-e-xl">

<div><img decoding="async" class="bg-token-main-surface-tertiary m-0 h-full w-full object-cover" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w7Kk6MVZN952C7oX22TfjQgD1-WcAz4tSpg89JdEUss3E6l4pagaBcV5YiKmh90eroY3It3S21zhp6W5kkKpWzolyhdy-ShxczduAZyYn9AwVyABgfPsToR9KASaI2WifPrNN4_0siKnjMPkjNdDsYVL3imjdXFWvKNIea_NoRmBFtR6i19RK9nZroA-NA8D?purpose=fullsize" data-lazy-src="https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w7Kk6MVZN952C7oX22TfjQgD1-WcAz4tSpg89JdEUss3E6l4pagaBcV5YiKmh90eroY3It3S21zhp6W5kkKpWzolyhdy-ShxczduAZyYn9AwVyABgfPsToR9KASaI2WifPrNN4_0siKnjMPkjNdDsYVL3imjdXFWvKNIea_NoRmBFtR6i19RK9nZroA-NA8D?purpose=fullsize" /></div>

<h3 data-section-id="1c1zb4d" data-start="3444" data-end="3491">The destination changes with the conditions</h3>
<p data-start="3493" data-end="3526">Kitesurfing is weather dependent.</p>
<p data-start="3528" data-end="3729">Instead of locking ourselves into a rigid itinerary, <strong data-start="3581" data-end="3729">our coaches will select the best riding location according to the day&#8217;s wind direction, strength, water conditions and the ability of the group.</strong></p>
<p data-start="3731" data-end="3792">That means more riding, better conditions and safer sessions.</p>
<hr data-start="3794" data-end="3797" />
<h1 data-section-id="1g8pk0u" data-start="3799" data-end="3822">5-Day Program</h1>
<h3 data-section-id="1fvxc6c" data-start="3824" data-end="3856">DAY 1 — Welcome to Kalpitiya</h3>
<p data-start="3858" data-end="3908">Arrive and settle into <strong data-start="3881" data-end="3907">Arasi Resort Kalpitiya</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="3910" data-end="4026">We&#8217;ll start with a group briefing covering the week&#8217;s program, local conditions, safety procedures and rider levels.</p>
<p data-start="4028" data-end="4065">Then it&#8217;s time for our first session.</p>
<p data-start="4067" data-end="4257"><strong data-start="4067" data-end="4080">Afternoon</strong><br />Kite setup and equipment check<br data-start="4111" data-end="4114" />Spot and safety briefing<br data-start="4138" data-end="4141" />First Kalpitiya riding session<br data-start="4171" data-end="4174" />Beginner and progression classes available<br data-start="4216" data-end="4219" />Sunset drinks and dinner at the resort</p>
<p data-start="4259" data-end="4361">The objective is simple: get everyone comfortable with the local conditions before we start exploring.</p>
<hr data-start="4363" data-end="4366" />
<h3 data-section-id="1dz7o2q" data-start="4368" data-end="4396">DAY 2 — Kalpitiya Lagoon</h3>
<p data-start="4398" data-end="4455">After breakfast, we head out for our first full kite day.</p>
<p data-start="4457" data-end="4637">Kalpitiya Lagoon provides wide riding areas and flat-water sections, making it an excellent location for both independent riders and coaching.</p>
<p data-start="4639" data-end="4773"><strong data-start="4639" data-end="4650">Morning</strong><br />Breakfast<br data-start="4660" data-end="4663" />Transfer to the kite spot<br data-start="4688" data-end="4691" />Warm-up and briefing<br data-start="4711" data-end="4714" />Kitesurf session<br data-start="4730" data-end="4733" />Beginner lessons<br data-start="4749" data-end="4752" />Intermediate coaching</p>
<p data-start="4775" data-end="4804"><strong data-start="4775" data-end="4784">Lunch</strong><br />Break and recharge.</p>
<p data-start="4806" data-end="4921"><strong data-start="4806" data-end="4819">Afternoon</strong><br />Second kite session<br data-start="4839" data-end="4842" />Technique and progression coaching<br data-start="4876" data-end="4879" />Freeride session<br data-start="4895" data-end="4898" />Optional sunset session</p>
<p data-start="4923" data-end="4971">Then it&#8217;s back to Arasi for dinner and recovery.</p>
<hr data-start="4973" data-end="4976" />
<h3 data-section-id="1eeuhj1" data-start="4978" data-end="5008">DAY 3 — Island Kite Safari</h3>
<p data-start="5010" data-end="5052">This is where the adventure really starts.</p>
<p data-start="5054" data-end="5183">We&#8217;ll load our equipment onto the boats and leave the main peninsula behind to discover one of Kalpitiya&#8217;s remote kite locations.</p>
<p data-start="5185" data-end="5312">Depending on conditions, the destination may include <strong data-start="5238" data-end="5311">Navy Point, Vella Island or another suitable island/sandbank location</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="5314" data-end="5503">Kalpitiya operators commonly use boats to access these remote riding areas, with the winter route selection depending on wind direction and conditions.</p>
<div class="no-scrollbar flex min-h-36 flex-nowrap gap-0.5 overflow-auto sm:gap-1 sm:overflow-hidden xl:min-h-44 mt-1 mb-5 not-first:mt-4">
<div class="border-token-border-default relative w-32 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-[0.5px] md:shrink max-h-64 sm:w-[calc((100%-0.5rem)/3)] rounded-s-xl">
<div class="group/search-image @container/search-image relative rounded-[inherit] h-full w-full">
<div> </div>
<div class="absolute end-2 top-2 z-10"> </div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="group/search-image @container/search-image relative rounded-[inherit] h-full w-full">
<div><img decoding="async" class="bg-token-main-surface-tertiary m-0 h-full w-full object-cover" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Mx-R2s_DLioeryxhb3sNtoyRoS2QJNpkWhe0cVQVrCPrklUbTjWOiT2tqVghtUnc9h8NXcpzVzei1LwWTp9czuzjyL6T5x_Y51m2Pk45JUOKYyWyVxguDD_7HHS1eIbIgbGlO4Nd3csJshxOH61y9_bWuq_rwJHzOBwyA4i5yD1b0oNwisyWVFxjCc9RGEVv?purpose=fullsize" data-lazy-src="https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Mx-R2s_DLioeryxhb3sNtoyRoS2QJNpkWhe0cVQVrCPrklUbTjWOiT2tqVghtUnc9h8NXcpzVzei1LwWTp9czuzjyL6T5x_Y51m2Pk45JUOKYyWyVxguDD_7HHS1eIbIgbGlO4Nd3csJshxOH61y9_bWuq_rwJHzOBwyA4i5yD1b0oNwisyWVFxjCc9RGEVv?purpose=fullsize" /></div>
<div class="absolute end-2 top-2 z-10"> </div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="5549" data-end="5677"><strong data-start="5549" data-end="5560">Morning</strong><br />Breakfast<br data-start="5570" data-end="5573" />Prepare equipment<br data-start="5590" data-end="5593" />Boat departure<br data-start="5607" data-end="5610" />Cruise through the lagoon and islands<br data-start="5647" data-end="5650" />Arrival and safety briefing</p>
<p data-start="5679" data-end="5759"><strong data-start="5679" data-end="5695">Kite Session</strong><br />Ride a completely different spot away from the main kite beach.</p>
<p data-start="5761" data-end="5803"><strong data-start="5761" data-end="5770">Lunch</strong><br />Island/beach lunch and recovery.</p>
<p data-start="5805" data-end="5891"><strong data-start="5805" data-end="5818">Afternoon</strong><br />Second kite session<br data-start="5838" data-end="5841" />Optional coaching<br data-start="5858" data-end="5861" />Boat journey back to Kalpitiya</p>
<p data-start="5893" data-end="5960">A full day dedicated to <strong data-start="5917" data-end="5960">kitesurfing, exploration and adventure.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="5962" data-end="5965" />
<h3 data-section-id="1roi72h" data-start="5967" data-end="6007">DAY 4 — Progression Day + Downwinder</h3>
<p data-start="6009" data-end="6051">Day four is about becoming a better rider.</p>
<p data-start="6053" data-end="6154">After several days on the water, it&#8217;s the perfect opportunity to work specifically on your technique.</p>
<p data-start="6156" data-end="6203">Depending on your level, coaching can focus on:</p>
<p data-start="6205" data-end="6356">Water starts<br data-start="6217" data-end="6220" />Riding upwind<br data-start="6233" data-end="6236" />Transitions<br data-start="6247" data-end="6250" />Toe-side riding<br data-start="6265" data-end="6268" />Jumping<br data-start="6275" data-end="6278" />Jump technique and landing<br data-start="6304" data-end="6307" />Freeride skills<br data-start="6322" data-end="6325" />Board control<br data-start="6338" data-end="6341" />Advanced tricks</p>
<p data-start="6358" data-end="6460">For suitable independent riders and conditions, we&#8217;ll also look at organising a <strong data-start="6438" data-end="6459">guided downwinder</strong>.</p>
<p data-start="6462" data-end="6653">Kalpitiya&#8217;s geography allows a variety of boat-supported downwind routes, including island-to-island itineraries when wind and water conditions permit.</p>
<p data-start="6655" data-end="6707">Finish the day with a relaxed evening back at Arasi.</p>
<hr data-start="6709" data-end="6712" />
<h3 data-section-id="od1bfu" data-start="6714" data-end="6746">DAY 5 — Final Kite Adventure</h3>
<p data-start="6748" data-end="6821">One last breakfast, one last briefing — and then we&#8217;re back on the water.</p>
<p data-start="6823" data-end="6907">We&#8217;ll choose the <strong data-start="6840" data-end="6880">best available kite spot of the trip</strong> according to the forecast.</p>
<p data-start="6909" data-end="6972">The final day is designed to give everyone maximum riding time.</p>
<p data-start="6974" data-end="7131">Independent riders can enjoy a long freeride session while students can book their final coaching session and consolidate everything learned during the week.</p>
<p data-start="7133" data-end="7218">We&#8217;ll finish with a final group session, photos and a farewell evening at the resort.</p>
<p data-start="7220" data-end="7249"><strong data-start="7220" data-end="7249">Eat. Sleep. Kite. Repeat.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="7251" data-end="7254" />
<h1 data-section-id="1avx9fj" data-start="7256" data-end="7290">Daily Kitesurf Classes Available</h1>
<p data-start="7292" data-end="7348">You don&#8217;t need to be an advanced rider to join the trip.</p>
<p data-start="7350" data-end="7464"><strong data-start="7350" data-end="7407">Kitesurf lessons and coaching are available every day</strong>, allowing riders of different levels to travel together.</p>
<h3 data-section-id="s7vrt7" data-start="7466" data-end="7479">Beginners</h3>
<p data-start="7481" data-end="7517">Never kitesurfed before? No problem.</p>
<p data-start="7519" data-end="7676">Start your progression during the trip with professional instruction covering kite control, safety systems, body dragging, water starts and your first rides.</p>
<h3 data-section-id="1wabrcc" data-start="7678" data-end="7701">Intermediate Riders</h3>
<p data-start="7703" data-end="7739">Already riding but want to progress?</p>
<p data-start="7741" data-end="7858">Work on riding upwind confidently, transitions, better board control, stronger kite positioning and your first jumps.</p>
<h3 data-section-id="1jo9wbn" data-start="7860" data-end="7879">Advanced Riders</h3>
<p data-start="7881" data-end="7987">Our coaches can help experienced riders work on technique, jumping, freeride and more advanced manoeuvres.</p>
<p data-start="7989" data-end="8065"><strong data-start="7989" data-end="8065">Private coaching can be added to your package according to availability.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="8067" data-end="8070" />
<h1 data-section-id="xclihk" data-start="8072" data-end="8110">Not a Kitesurfer? You Can Still Join</h1>
<p data-start="8112" data-end="8152">Partners and family members are welcome.</p>
<p data-start="8154" data-end="8193">Kalpitiya isn&#8217;t only about kitesurfing.</p>
<p data-start="8195" data-end="8271">Depending on availability and conditions, additional activities can include:</p>
<p data-start="8273" data-end="8441"><strong data-start="8273" data-end="8441">Island &amp; lagoon boat trips • dolphin watching • SUP • kayaking • beach days • local village exploration • Wilpattu National Park excursions • relaxing at the resort</strong></p>
<p data-start="8443" data-end="8644">Dolphin-watching excursions are offered locally during this part of the year, while Wilpattu excursions are another established activity from the Kalpitiya area.</p>
<p data-start="8646" data-end="8747">This makes the trip suitable for <strong data-start="8679" data-end="8747">couples and families where not everyone wants to kite every day.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="8749" data-end="8752" />
<h1 data-section-id="2r2kkp" data-start="8754" data-end="8790">Your Base — Arasi Resort Kalpitiya</h1>
<p data-start="8792" data-end="8866">For the duration of the trip, <strong data-start="8822" data-end="8848">Arasi Resort Kalpitiya</strong> will be our home.</p>
<p data-start="8868" data-end="8995">After long days on the water, return to the resort, relax, eat, recover and get ready to do it all again the following morning.</p>
<p data-start="8997" data-end="9032">The concept is deliberately simple:</p>
<p data-start="9034" data-end="9092"><strong data-start="9034" data-end="9092">Wake up → Breakfast → Kite → Explore → Relax → Repeat.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="9094" data-end="9097" />
<h1 data-section-id="1jxbixs" data-start="9099" data-end="9116">What&#8217;s Included</h1>
<p data-start="9118" data-end="9145">Your trip package includes:</p>
<p data-start="9147" data-end="9653">✓ Accommodation at <strong data-start="9166" data-end="9192">Arasi Resort Kalpitiya</strong><br data-start="9192" data-end="9195" />✓ Daily breakfast<br data-start="9212" data-end="9215" />✓ Daily organised kitesurf sessions<br data-start="9250" data-end="9253" />✓ Local kite spot guidance<br data-start="9279" data-end="9282" />✓ Group safety briefings<br data-start="9306" data-end="9309" />✓ Kite spot transfers included in the planned program<br data-start="9362" data-end="9365" />✓ Organised island/boat kite trip during the week<br data-start="9414" data-end="9417" />✓ Boat support for scheduled kite safari where applicable<br data-start="9474" data-end="9477" />✓ Group progression advice<br data-start="9503" data-end="9506" />✓ Kite equipment storage at the resort/centre<br data-start="9551" data-end="9554" />✓ Welcome briefing<br data-start="9572" data-end="9575" />✓ Final group evening<br data-start="9596" data-end="9599" />✓ On-site assistance from our team throughout the trip</p>
<p data-start="9655" data-end="9804"><strong data-start="9655" data-end="9735">Daily lessons, private coaching and equipment rental can be added separately</strong>, allowing each rider to customise the trip according to their level.</p>
<hr data-start="9806" data-end="9809" />
<h1 data-section-id="gya7rp" data-start="9811" data-end="9832">What&#8217;s Not Included</h1>
<p data-start="9834" data-end="10356">✗ Flights to/from Sri Lanka<br data-start="9861" data-end="9864" />✗ Sri Lanka visa/ETA where required<br data-start="9899" data-end="9902" />✗ Travel insurance<br data-start="9920" data-end="9923" />✗ Kitesurf-specific insurance<br data-start="9952" data-end="9955" />✗ Personal kite equipment<br data-start="9980" data-end="9983" />✗ Kite equipment rental unless booked separately<br data-start="10031" data-end="10034" />✗ Private kitesurf lessons/coaching unless added to your package<br data-start="10098" data-end="10101" />✗ Airport transfers unless specifically included in your booking<br data-start="10165" data-end="10168" />✗ Lunches and dinners unless specified in your final package<br data-start="10228" data-end="10231" />✗ Alcoholic beverages and personal expenses<br data-start="10274" data-end="10277" />✗ Optional excursions such as wildlife safaris or additional private boat trips</p>
<p data-start="10358" data-end="10424"><strong data-start="10358" data-end="10424">Travel insurance covering kitesurfing is strongly recommended.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="10426" data-end="10429" />
<h1 data-section-id="1buexhl" data-start="10431" data-end="10455">What Should You Bring?</h1>
<p data-start="10457" data-end="10495">Bring your normal tropical kite setup.</p>
<p data-start="10497" data-end="10805">Your exact kite sizes will depend on your weight and the forecast. Local winter guidance describes winds averaging approximately <strong data-start="10626" data-end="10641">15–22 knots</strong>, so riders should ideally travel with enough kite range to cover lighter and stronger days rather than relying on one kite.</p>
<p data-start="10807" data-end="10820">Don&#8217;t forget:</p>
<p data-start="10822" data-end="11008">Harness<br data-start="10829" data-end="10832" />Board<br data-start="10837" data-end="10840" />Kites + bar<br data-start="10851" data-end="10854" />Pump<br data-start="10858" data-end="10861" />Repair kit/spares<br data-start="10878" data-end="10881" />Rash vest<br data-start="10890" data-end="10893" />Sun protection<br data-start="10907" data-end="10910" />Sunglasses<br data-start="10920" data-end="10923" />Hat<br data-start="10926" data-end="10929" />Reusable water bottle<br data-start="10950" data-end="10953" />Personal medication<br data-start="10972" data-end="10975" />Travel/kitesurf insurance details</p>
<p data-start="11010" data-end="11086">Equipment rental can also be arranged for riders who prefer to travel light.</p>
<hr data-start="11088" data-end="11091" />
<h1 data-section-id="efh66r" data-start="11093" data-end="11123">Three Dates. Limited Places.</h1>
<h3 data-section-id="1og1y4a" data-start="11125" data-end="11151">🎄 Christmas Kite Trip</h3>
<p data-start="11152" data-end="11175"><strong data-start="11152" data-end="11175">21–25 December 2026</strong></p>
<p data-start="11177" data-end="11244">Five days of kitesurfing and tropical island life before Christmas.</p>
<h3 data-section-id="124a3gj" data-start="11246" data-end="11271">🎆 New Year Kite Trip</h3>
<p data-start="11272" data-end="11309"><strong data-start="11272" data-end="11309">28 December 2026 – 2 January 2027</strong></p>
<p data-start="11311" data-end="11418">Celebrate New Year in Sri Lanka — with kites, warm water and a completely different kind of New Year&#8217;s Eve.</p>
<h3 data-section-id="1t1n14" data-start="11420" data-end="11444">🌴 January Kite Trip</h3>
<p data-start="11445" data-end="11465"><strong data-start="11445" data-end="11465">4–8 January 2027</strong></p>
<p data-start="11467" data-end="11531">Start 2027 exactly as you mean to continue it: <strong data-start="11514" data-end="11531">on the water.</strong></p>
<hr data-start="11533" data-end="11536" />
<h1 data-section-id="1kgex2g" data-start="11538" data-end="11560">Ready for Sri Lanka?</h1>
<p data-start="11562" data-end="11584">Leave the city behind.</p>
<p data-start="11586" data-end="11718">Come ride warm water, explore remote islands, improve your kitesurfing and experience one of Asia&#8217;s great kite destinations with us.</p>
<p data-start="11720" data-end="11745"><strong data-start="11720" data-end="11745">Kalpitiya is waiting.</strong></p>
<h3 data-section-id="1gb8y8a" data-start="11747" data-end="11777">KITESURF SRI LANKA 2026/27</h3>
<p data-start="11779" data-end="11821">📍 <strong data-start="11782" data-end="11821">Arasi Resort – Kalpitiya, Sri Lanka</strong></p>
<p data-start="11823" data-end="11918">📅 <strong data-start="11826" data-end="11849">21–25 December 2026</strong><br data-start="11849" data-end="11852" />📅 <strong data-start="11855" data-end="11892">28 December 2026 – 2 January 2027</strong><br data-start="11892" data-end="11895" />📅 <strong data-start="11898" data-end="11918">4–8 January 2027</strong></p>
<p data-start="11920" data-end="11948"><strong data-start="11920" data-end="11948">Limited riders per trip.</strong></p>
<p data-start="11950" data-end="11972">👉 <strong data-start="11953" data-end="11972">BOOK YOUR PLACE</strong></p>
<p data-start="11974" data-end="12018">👉 <strong data-start="11977" data-end="12018">WHATSAPP US FOR PRICES &amp; AVAILABILITY</strong></p>
<p data-start="11974" data-end="12018"> </p>
<h1 data-start="11974" data-end="12018"><strong>Price: 4900 dhs per person. </strong></h1>
